segments.t: Outside the Mansart restaurant, senior agent Arlette spots their ruthless rival François Bréhier dining with Samuel Kerr's widow. Meanwhile at the ASK agency, Gabriel and Noémie examine a sensational gossip magazine revealing Virginie Efira's secret lover. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
C'est le directeur de StarMedia avec la femme de Samuel Kerr.
Elle trompe Ramzy? Ce n'est pas possible.
Elle le quitte? Des histoires de couple, c'est ma veine.
On sait qui est le type sur la photo?
Un mètre soixante-quinze, plutôt poilu, beau postérieur... C'est toi, Gabriel?
Une rupture pendant la sortie du film, c'est mauvais pour nous.
Au contraire, ça va faire le buzz! C'est pimenté!
Noémie! Je parle d'image, pas de buzz.
S'ils se séparent maintenant, c'est un désastre pour le film.
Il ne manquait plus que ça! Tout va mal ce matin.
Comment ça? Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
Je viens de voir François Bréhier avec Hélène Kerr chez Mansart.
Il veut nous racheter? C'est notre plus grand rival!
Bréhier est un charognard. Il ferait n'importe quoi pour nous couler.

'She is leaving him? Couple dramas are just my luck.' Noémie remarks on the constant relationship trouble at the agency.

'Do we know who the guy in the photo is?' Gabriel tries to identify the mystery lover in the blurry picture.

'Five feet nine, quite hairy, nice rear... Is it you, Gabriel?' Noémie jokes that the physical description matches Gabriel.

'A breakup during the film release is bad for us.' Gabriel points out that bad personal publicity hurts box office sales.

'On the contrary, it will create buzz! It is spicy!' Noémie argues that scandal attracts media attention.

'Noémie! I am talking about image, not buzz.' Gabriel insists that prestige and trust matter more than gossip.

'If they break up now, it is a disaster for the film.' Gabriel pairs the verb meaning 'separate' with the noun for 'flop.'.

'That is the last thing we needed! Everything is going wrong this morning.' Arlette announces that an even bigger crisis is brewing.
Comment ça? Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
'What do you mean? What is happening?' Gabriel asks for clarification about her warning.
Je viens de voir François Bréhier avec Hélène Kerr chez Mansart.
'I just saw François Bréhier with Hélène Kerr at Mansart.' The key word here means 'come', paired with 'see' to make the point clear.
Il veut nous racheter? C'est notre plus grand rival!
'He wants to buy us out? He is our biggest rival!' Noémie expresses immediate alarm at StarMédia acquiring their shares.

Arlette's discovery confirms the agents' worst fears: François Bréhier is actively trying to buy out ASK while Virginie and Ramzy's romance unravels. Mathias immediately gathers all the partners in the conference room for an emergency financial meeting. See you next time!
Bonne journée!
